dog.description_text:
Meet Ice Maker (aka Ripley), a sweet, affectionate, 8 month old Lab/Border Collie/Hound mix who loves cuddles and attention! She’s happiest close to her people, whether she’s snuggling on the couch, curling up at the foot of the bed or lounging nearby. She’s also remarkably quiet. Her foster hasn’t heard her bark once, though she does make adorable little groans, moans and dramatic sighs when she settles in to get comfy.

Ice Maker has a great balance of playful energy and calm. She loves walks, walks well on a leash, and is a curious explorer who sniffs everything along the way. She’s starting to get more interested in playing with other dogs, and she still has some puppy zoomies and excited jumping. She’s great with dogs, kids and adults of all ages, but she hasn’t been tested with cats. She’s crate trained, sleeps through the night, does fine on her own for 4–5 hours, and has adjusted well to apartment living. She’s doing well with potty training and reliably goes outside, though she’s young and still learning her routine. She knows her name, and she’s ready to learn some commands!

Ice Maker is a loving, happy-go-lucky girl with an adventurous side who also knows how to relax and enjoy a good cuddle. She’d be a wonderful fit for an active family that wants both a walking buddy and a couch companion.

If you would like to adopt this Rockstar, please visit www.pupstarzrescue.org for an application!
